brief: Prioritise pre-event attention for Langmere Dale 230/34kV ahead of younger units, as its advanced age and high loading history reduce its margin against mechanical failure [MG-023]. Review open work orders against the asset to re-prioritise outstanding work according to its effect on the unit's ability to shed heat [SOP-016]. If an ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023].
